item.description: Good morning, Sydney, and a very happy Friday, May 1st, 2026! Welcome back to your Daily Drive, ready to power you through this beautiful autumn day. We're looking at a lovely 22 degrees and sunny today, perfect for enjoying the start of a long weekend for some, and remember, it's also International Workers' Day globally. Did you know that the "Mayday" distress signal actually comes from the French "m'aider," meaning "help me"? Have a fantastic day, and let's get moving!
